## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Esoteric dhāraṇī-sūtra on **Mārīcī** by **Amoghavajra** ([不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA)); the second of the Mārīcī cluster ([KR6j0483](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0483)–[KR6j0489](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0489), T1254–T1259) and the first of the two parallel renderings preserved as T1255a/b. Korean Tripiṭaka K1354; Nanjio 0846. Alternate title 摩利支天經.

**Abstract**

A more compact rendering of the Mārīcī-dhāraṇī material than the full *Huāmán* sūtra of [KR6j0483](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0483) (T1254): the framing-narrative is shorter, the iconographic exposition compressed, and the focus is on the dhāraṇī itself together with its essential ritual conditions. The text is thus the **practitioner's-handbook** counterpart of T1254. Date: Amoghavajra's Chángān activity, 746–774.
